Overview

Constanța is a city in Constanța with a population of 283,872. Romania’s oldest continuously inhabited city and main Black Sea port, with ancient Roman ruins, sandy beaches, and a bustling maritime atmosphere. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5b growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
